dct_title_s: Indonesia Semeru Volcano: Damage Proxy Maps, Dec 2022
dct_description_sm: # Indonesia Semeru Volcano: Damage Proxy Maps, Dec 2022 The **Earth Observatory of Singapore – Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS)** produced these damage proxy maps for Indonesia Semeru Volcano (Dec 2022) from synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite images. Each map is a separate ZIP below with its GeoTIFF, a KMZ for Google Earth, the PNG figures and a text file describing how it was made and how to read it. ## Maps in this dataset - **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: Indonesia, Semeru Volcano, 14 Dec 2022, v0.9 wbd** (superseded) - **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: Indonesia, Semeru Volcano, 14 Dec 2022, v0.9 wbd** (superseded) - **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: Indonesia, Semeru Volcano, 14 Dec 2022, v0.9** - **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: Indonesia, Semeru Volcano, 14 Dec 2022, v0.9** **More map details and files:** **More map details and files:** **Credits:** Earth Observatory of Singapore - Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS), Advanced Rapid Imaging and Analysis (ARIA), NASA-JPL/Caltech, Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data (2022)
